newsitem.title: CANADA: Ontario health minister resigns amid privacy probe.
newsitem.headline: Ontario health minister resigns amid privacy probe.

text.p: Ontario Conservative Health Minister Jim Wilson said on Monday that he will temporarily resign his cabinet post during a probe into leaked confidential information from his department.
Wilson's decision followed the weekend resignation of his media spokesman, Brett James, who had disclosed billing information to the Toronto Globe and Mail newspaper last week.
James told the newspaper that William Hughes, vice-chairman of the Specialist Coalition of Ontario, had the highest billings to the provincial health insurance plan of any doctor in Ontario.

The controversy comes as doctors and the government remain embroiled in a dispute of over doctors' billings. The ruling Conservatives have proposed to claw back 10 percent of what physicians bill to the Ontario Health Insurance Plan.
Premier Mike Harris said in a statement that the province's privacy commissioner had been asked to investigate the information leak.

"It is the minister's view that the integrity of this process must be maintained and has, therefore, done the honourable thing by stepping aside pending the outcome of the investigation," Harris said.
Management Board Chairman Dave Johnson will assume the responsibilities of Minister of Health in the interim, Harris said.
